goal: Decide and record the minimal offline first-party metadata path compatibility repair after the frozen parser rejected exact pinned real metadata.
scope: Read Leader preflight report and current formal decisions; record APPROVED, REVISE or PAUSE in product knowledge base, PRD, INDEX and change log.

stop_conditions: Need to expand source authorization, introduce network or reuse old source bodies, relax traversal/identity/budget/privacy/checkpoint gates: stop with REVISE or PAUSE.
